nxdialog_dialog_type.description: Type of dialog to show. Options: yesno, ok, error, panic, quit, pulldown, yesnosuspend.

nxdialog_message.description: Text message to be displayed in the dialog box.

nxdialog_caption.description: Title string for the dialog window.

nxdialog_display.description: X11 display string (e.g., ':0'). If empty, uses the $DISPLAY environment variable.

nxdialog_parent_pid.description: Process ID of the parent nxagent process. Use 0 for standalone testing.

nxdialog_window_id.description: X11 Window ID for embedding pulldown dialogs. Leave empty if not using pulldown or embedding.

nxdialog_msg_class.description: Message class for styling/icon. Options: info, warning, error.

nxdialog_use_local.description: Enable proxy mode (currently unimplemented in binary but passed as flag).

nxdialog_allow_multiple.description: Allow multiple instances of the same dialog to run (currently unimplemented in binary but passed as flag).
